title: Unopened Prescription Diet Returns at Tailwise Pharmacy
content:
## Rule

Dispensed medications are never accepted back by Tailwise Pharmacy for resale or refund, opened or not. Only unopened prescription diet product may be returned, and only where the class's unopened-return window is above 0 days.

An unopened prescription diet return is accepted only if it is requested no later than the class's unopened-return window after the returned fill's dispense date. The return window is counted in calendar days from the dispense date of the returned fill on the pharmacy ledger, that date being day 0; a request on the last day is in time.

The refund is the returned packages' share of the fill's merchandise amount after discount, less the class's restocking fee percentage, paid to the original payment. Shipping is not refunded, and the fill is not credited back to the prescription.

## Window boundary (hypothetical dates, 60-day window)

- Fill dispensed 2026-03-01 (day 0). Day 60 is 2026-04-30.
- A request on 2026-04-30 is in time; a request on 2026-05-01 is not.

## Refund worked through (hypothetical figures)

A prescription diet fill of 3 bags had a merchandise subtotal of $180.00 and no discount. One unopened bag is returned within the window. The returned packages' share is one third of $180.00, that is $60.00. With a restocking fee of 0 percent, $60.00 is refunded to the original payment. The fill's shipping fee is not refunded and the prescription's fills remaining do not change.

## Points of judgement

| Product returned | Opened? | Accepted? |
|---|---|---|
| Prescription diet | No, within the window | Yes |
| Prescription diet | No, after the window | No |
| Prescription diet | Yes | No |
| Any medication | Either | No |
